jobs.prompt: Using the reference giraffe exactly (same pale sandy coat, same soft tan patch pattern, same animal), generate a single adult reticulated giraffe mid-stride walking left, full body including all four hooves, isolated on a flat ivory field (RGB 255,255,240), soft even studio light, only a faint contact shadow. Photoreal wildlife photography.

The giraffe walks calmly from right to left at a natural walking pace, four full strides, head level, tail swaying slightly. Flat ivory background throughout. Nothing else in frame. No morphing, no flicker, no extra animals. Camera locked off, no camera movement, no zoom.

Both giraffes turn away from the camera together, slowly, and walk straight up the centre steps toward the ivy-covered stone house, seen from behind and getting smaller until they match the final frame. Natural giraffe walking gait, necks swaying. The people on the terrace stay still. The house and terrace do not change. No morphing, no extra animals. Camera locked off, no camera movement, no zoom.
jobs.note: Round 1 takes 3 and 4 (first+last frame) land the giraffes on the centre steps from behind by f58; f0-58 is lateral travel. Take 3 f58-120 is cut into animatic v0.2. Retry only if Allen wants a true in-place turn.

_model_policy: Endpoints are recommendations. Sol may substitute any Higgsfield model that serves the shot better (Kling O3 first-last-frame, Seedance, Wan, GPT Image, FLUX, Qwen) and records the endpoint actually used in the ledger. Compositing with rotoscoping in After Effects is acceptable, so clean separable elements beat perfect in-plate integration.
